messages.summary:
## Objective
- Change the game’s graphics and visuals to a mythical feudal Japanese theme. The repository had no existing game implementation, so the assistant began building a complete playable game from scratch.

## Requirements
- “Change the graphics and visuals to be Mythical Fuedal Japanese themed”.
- Build a complete, playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a standalone, single-file HTML5 canvas game named “Moonveil — The Last Torii,” featuring a samurai defending a moonlit shrine against yokai.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` with procedural Japanese-themed canvas scenery, HUD, wave-based combat, yokai and boss enemies, keyboard/touch controls, and menu/pause/game-over screens.
- JavaScript syntax initially validated successfully.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/current.jpg`; the initial desktop view showed the designed game screen.
- Confirmed touch controls are visible on mobile dimensions.

### Active
- Fix a browser runtime error introduced or exposed in the latest `index.html` revision; mobile and desktop testing reported `Invalid or unexpected token`, preventing the start button from starting the game.
- Re-test gameplay and take/read a fresh `screenshots/current.jpg` after fixing the error.

### Blocked
- Browser gameplay verification is blocked by the JavaScript runtime error. Playwright reports `Invalid or unexpected token` on both desktop and mobile, and the menu remains visible after clicking “BEGIN THE VIGIL”.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current inline script in `index.html` for a malformed token, especially the recently edited wave-update logic.
2. Fix the JavaScript error and verify the start button, wave progression, and controls in desktop and mobile browsers.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main standalone game implementation; current runtime error is here.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/current.jpg`: Latest visual check; currently reflects the mobile view captured before diagnosing the error.

## Important Context
- The last code edit modified wave progression in `update(dt)` to replace a repeatedly scheduled timeout with a timer-based transition; runtime validation after this edit produced `Invalid or unexpected token`.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` previously showed `?? index.html`.
- A local Python server was started on port 3002. Playwright testing used `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright` with `/usr/bin/chromium`.
